title: 16 x9 Grid Application
slide_intent: Show how a square grid can organize a video title card so the audience can distinguish the subject, title and publisher.
strategic_value: Instacart can identify instructional material with a quiet signature while giving the lesson title enough space to read.
demonstration: The grid overlays a cream card with an Ads Manager label, a two-line title for a sponsored-product lesson, and the signature near the bottom.
practical_value: Align the lesson label, title and signature to one grid column, then choose their vertical positions by assigning different rows.

content_islands.name: Slide label
content_islands.spec: Set the application heading at upper left against dark green.

content_islands.name: Teaching card
content_islands.spec: Leave the cyan square grid visible on the cream field. Align the small label above the large title and the wordmark below, all to the same inset.
